claims.text: A Pulumi package is the unit of versioning and distribution, and the components inside it inherit the package's version.
Pulumi recommends structuring Git repositories with one package per repository for publishing packages.
A source-based plugin package is distributed as source code in a Git repository, and its version is the Git tag on that repository.
Publishing a source-based package to the Pulumi IDP Private Registry is a two-step flow: apply a semver Git tag, then run `pulumi package publish`.
`pulumi package publish` sends the package metadata to Pulumi Cloud and places the package in the Private Registry.

Semver-tagged releases are only required for publishing to the Private Registry; source-based packages referenced directly from a `Pulumi.yaml` can use any Git ref (tag, branch, or commit), even if not a valid semantic version.
Executable-based plugin packages are distributed as pre-built plugin binaries, typically with per-language SDKs published to feeds (npm, PyPI, NuGet, Maven, Go module proxy, or private equivalents).
An executable-based package's version is the version embedded in the published binary and SDKs.
Pulumi Cloud customers can additionally publish an executable-based package to the Private Registry via `pulumi package publish`.
A repository containing multiple packages must either release them in lockstep or invent per-package release tooling that fights how Pulumi consumes packages.
The Amazon EKS package in the Pulumi Registry bundles a managed Kubernetes cluster component along with supporting components needed to secure and operate it.
One `PulumiPlugin.yaml` at the repository root defines the package, with components living alongside it.
Bundling unrelated components into one package versions every component the same way on each release, which violates semver.

Links to internal docs exist: /docs/iac/concepts/packages/, /docs/iac/concepts/components/, packaging-components anchors, /docs/idp/concepts/private-registry/, /docs/iac/cli/commands/pulumi_package_publish/, and publishing-packages.
